description: The channel's recurring cartoon cast: which characters exist, their voice, and which rig folder under long-compose/remotion/public/characters/ renders them. Supplied as a graph input for a cartoon-mode run, like intent - a channel's cast changes rarely and deliberately, so it is not AI-generated per episode.

character_id.description: Stable id the dialogue writer uses as script.scenes[].speaker.

name.description: Display name, e.g. for the dialogue writer's prompt.

voice_id.description: TTS voice id for this character's lines.

rig.description: Folder name under long-compose/remotion/public/characters/ - may differ from character_id (multiple characters can share a rig).

personality.description: Short blurb for the dialogue writer, e.g. "skeptical, dry humor, asks the obvious question".

default_voice_id.description: Fallback voice when a scene's speaker isn't found in characters[] (should not normally happen).
